full_prompt_en: This is a square, monochrome landscape image of a solitary figure on a dark ridge overlooking a vast misty mountain valley. The foreground rises from the lower left as an almost black slope covered with rough grass and low vegetation. Near the center-left crest, one small seated or crouched figure faces away toward the open distance, reduced to a simple dark silhouette. A sparse tree mass closes the far left edge, while steep mountain walls sweep down from both sides toward a pale valley floor. Layer after layer of gray ridges recedes into haze, becoming lighter and softer toward the center. Above them, enormous billowing clouds fill most of the sky, with a bright opening high on the left and darker cloud faces piling toward the upper right. Diffuse daylight passes through the cloud gap, washing the distant terrain in silver and leaving the near hillside in deep shadow. The ground around the figure is not evenly lit; its grasses and rocks are visible mainly at the dark-to-light boundary. Small specks in the upper sky add a faint grainlike texture. The composition uses a low, dark foreground anchor against a luminous central distance and broad cloud mass. No buildings, signs, or readable text appear. The figure's scale makes the valley feel immense without needing a detailed narrative. The overall image is quiet and contemplative, moving through a full range from near-black earth to white cloud light while remaining entirely within grayscale.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形单色风景图，一名孤身人物位于深色山脊上，俯瞰辽阔而多雾的山谷。前景从左下升起，成为近乎黑色的斜坡，覆着粗草与低矮植被。中央偏左的坡顶附近，一道小小的坐着或蹲着的身影背对镜头，面向开阔远方，被简化成深色剪影。稀疏树丛封住最左边缘，两侧陡峭山壁朝浅色谷底滑落。一层层灰色山脊退入薄雾，越向中央越浅、越柔。其上，巨大的翻卷云层填满大部分天空，左上有明亮开口，更暗的云面堆向右上。散射日光透过云隙，把远处地势洗成银色，近处山坡则保留深影。人物周围的地面并非均匀受光；草和石主要在明暗交界处可见。上方天空的小斑点增添淡淡颗粒肌理。构图以低处深色前景支点平衡发亮的中央远方和宽阔云团。没有建筑、标志或可读文字。人物的尺度使山谷显得巨大，无需详尽叙事。整体图像安静而沉思，从近黑土地一路过渡到白色云光，却始终完全保持在灰阶之内。
style_prompt_en: The grayscale treatment explores a wide tonal range from near-black foreground mass to silvery middle distance and luminous white upper light. Broad atmospheric gradients separate receding layers, while rough granular texture stays concentrated near the close dark edge. Large billowing shapes balance one compact low silhouette, giving scale without crowding. Diffuse light enters through a high opening, making distant planes pale and letting the nearest planes fall into shadow. Edges sharpen in the foreground and soften progressively with distance. The composition relies on diagonal enclosure around a bright central interval and generous upper space. The overall effect is expansive, meditative, and dramatic, with black, gray, and white carrying all of its visual structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这种灰阶处理探索从近黑前景体量，到银色中景与发亮白色上方光线的宽阔明度范围。大面积空气渐变区分逐层后退的部分，粗颗粒肌理则集中在近处深色边缘。大型翻卷形态平衡一处低位紧凑剪影，提供尺度而不拥挤。散射光从高处开口进入，使远方平面变浅，最近的平面落入阴影。近处边缘较清楚，随距离逐渐柔化。构图依靠围住明亮中央间隔的斜向框架，以及充足的上方空间。整体效果开阔、冥想而富于戏剧性，黑、灰、白承载全部视觉结构。
theme_en: A solitary figure overlooking a misty mountain valley in monochrome
theme_zh: 孤身人物俯瞰黑白雾气中的山谷
name: Grayscale
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
